_about: The branch of Peter Kastl, one of the seven brothers. See docs/EXTRACTION.md.

peter-kastl-1827.name: Peter Kastl
peter-kastl-1827.summary: The first to come to America, about 1866

facts.value: Sts. Cyril and Methodius (Plasi) cemetery, Saunders County, Nebraska

sources.quote: Both are buried in the cemetery at Sts. Cyril and Methodius Church, known as Plasi, Saunders County, Nebraska.
He was married in Bohemia January 1859 to Miss Anna Frohner

facts.value: 1866; the first of the brothers to come to America

sources.quote: Peter was the first to leave. The year is unclear.
Andreas' History of Nebraska, Volume II, page 1400, states Peter came in 1866.

facts.value: Served as an officer in the Austrian Army; first settler in Elk Precinct, Saunders County.

sources.quote: Peter, the oldest and the first to leave Bohemia, was an officer in the Austrian Army.
He was the first settler in Elk precinct—Saunders County and the first Czech in Butler and Saunders Counties.
